descriptions.w3d_d21a_audio_theme_8002988c: Audio theme start-up: maps Land.Theme (ENGLAND/HORROR/WAR/LUNAR/PIRATE/ARCTIC, default ENGLAND) and Land.TimeOfDay (DAY/EVENING/NIGHT/RANDOM) to a theme and day/night, starts a random one of the theme's four music tracks into +28 and the day or night ambience into +32 via the audio service, applies Audio.Vol.Music and Audio.Vol.Ambient to them, sets audio option 19 from Audio.Vol.Sfx (default 1.0) and subscribes the handlers at +44, +48, +52 to three cached messages.
